in_sanskrit.name: रागवः
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules, a king or leader.

in_marathi.name: Ragav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Ragas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ragav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ragav is a Hindu name for boys that means 'King of Ragas'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rāga', which refers to a melodic framework for improvisation in Indian classical music.

in_bengali.name: Ragav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King of Ragas
